text:
Jules: uploaded two filtered views for billing: 'smart-filter' (collapsible filter rail + compact rows) vs 'detail-first' (always-visible filters, expanded rows). Quick gut-checks before PM review?
Aman: drop link
Jules: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE/billing-filter-views
Rae: smart-filter saves vertical space but hides invoice-scoped actions until expand. worried support will see more "where's download" tickets.
Priya: detail-first makes actions discoverable but is noisy for accounts with many invoices. mobile becomes very tall.
Caleb: accessibility note: compact rows use token shorthand like "9k" 14 voiceover reads weird. add aria-label="9,000 tokens" or show full value for sr-only.
Jules: good catch. also debating filter defaults: show "All orgs" or last-used scope? default affects discoverability of org-level invoices.
Aman: last-used scope is better for power users; but new users expect "All orgs". maybe remember per-account but show hint about scope with an inline link "Why this scope?"
Rae: keyboard nav: in compact rows the expand chevron isn't in tab order. make row focusable and Enter toggles expand. add aria-expanded on the row.
Priya: payment CTA placement: propose inline small "Pay" only for overdue >30d, otherwise keep Pay in overflow. always show download on hover/overflow.
Caleb: plus confirmation modal for Pay. analytics: pilot 2 weeks, 30% smart-filter+compact, 30% detail-first, 40% control. track invoice_downloads, pay_confirmed, support_ticket_keyword:"invoice", avg_rows_expanded.
prod-bot: Jules uploaded updated mocks (smart-filter-v2, detail-first-v1)
Jules: updated: aria-labels for token shorthand, keyboard-focusable rows, added scope-hint, overdue inline Pay only, Pay confirm micro-modal, trimmed expand animation to 100ms. will add pilot to tomorrow's agenda (7m). ping me for any last-minute a11y or metrics asks. :thumbsup:
